ai_explanation_template: The collision of Shakespearean language with flamenco's intensity suggests you're curious about classical work that doesn't feel preserved in amber. The rarity of the play itself means fewer preconceptions to navigate.

title: The Scarlet Lotus
description: London Cabaret Collective transform a Mayfair venue into an immersive cabaret world. Fire, burlesque, and circus disciplines converge in a premium-priced evening designed to surround rather than simply present.
ai_explanation_template: The layering of circus, burlesque, and fire performance in an immersive setting suggests you're after spectacle that feels tactile and close rather than observed from a distance. The Mayfair location signals a polished, late-night atmosphere.
